blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A day before World Teachers’ Day, Alliance of Concerned Teachers (ACT) Philippines on Sunday staged a protest outside Malacañang, demanding a P50,000 entry-level salary. The teachers’ group also called for a P5,000 Personnel Economic Relief Allowance (PERA), and higher government spending on education. READ: Government workers continue to push for P5,000 PERA ACT also urged the government to allocate 6% of the country’s gross domestic product to education, saying additional funding was needed to address shortages, deteriorating school conditions and the country’s learning crisis. The protesters likewise called for greater accountability over corruption, saying inadequate funding for education and other […]...
